summary: Backend auth API re-verified via pytest (13/13 pass: register success/dup/short-pw, login success/wrong-pw/unknown, /auth/me with valid/missing/invalid token, forgot-password known/unknown email, reset-password invalid code). Frontend E2E via Playwright on public URL passes all requested flows: (1) Settings Account section shows Sign In + Create Account when logged out; (2) Register flow creates account and returns to Settings signed-in state; (3) Sign Out on web signs out directly without confirm dialog and clears localStorage token; (4) Sign In with existing credentials (testsenior@example.com / newpass123) returns to Settings signed-in state; (5) Sign In wrong password shows inline error 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.'; (6) Register with short password (<6) and mismatched passwords both show inline validation errors; (7) Forgot Password step 1 -> step 2 transitions correctly, code + new-password fields render; (8) Session persists across page reload (token restored via /auth/me); (9) All 7 tabs (Planner, Grocery, Calculator, Notes, News, Chat, Settings) render without red-screen errors after routing restructure. No blocking issues found.

issues: Interactive elements lack testID attributes (Sign In / Create Account rows, form inputs, primary buttons). Tests had to fall back to text/placeholder selectors, which are fragile if copy changes. Recommend adding testIDs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, register-name-input, register-email-input, register-password-input, register-confirm-input, register-submit-btn, forgot-email-input, forgot-send-code-btn, forgot-code-input, forgot-new-password-input, forgot-reset-btn, settings-sign-in-row, settings-create-account-row, settings-sign-out-row, account-user-name, account-user-email.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Add testID props to auth screens and Settings account rows so future automated tests are copy-agnostic.

(Observation, not a bug) Expo Router keeps previously visited screens mounted in the DOM on web, so text/placeholder selectors return multiple matches (e.g. two you@example.com inputs after navigating login -> forgot-password). This did not affect functionality but does require .last / testID usage in tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which are deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers. Not blocking.
AuthContext.tsx correctly uses localStorage on web + SecureStore on native, calls /auth/me on mount to restore session, and clears token on 401. Good.
Login/Register/Forgot screens have KeyboardAvoidingView, ScrollView with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled', 60px min touch targets, high-contrast error boxes - matches senior-friendly design goals.
Backend /auth/forgot-password returns generic 200 for unknown emails (no user enumeration) - good.
server.py hash_password uses bcrypt with a 72-char max on the Pydantic model to avoid bcrypt truncation - good.
seed_data_creation: Registered a few TEST_uitest_<timestamp>@example.com users during flow testing (prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup). Existing testsenior@example.com password remains newpass123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is https://easy-productivity-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Auth screens are reached via Settings tab > Account section (there is NO route guard). Token stored in localStorage['auth_token'] on web. Expo Router keeps prior stack screens mounted on web, so duplicate placeholder inputs may appear in DOM; use .last or add testIDs. Existing user: testsenior@example.com / newpass123. Do NOT attempt full password-reset E2E - the 6-digit code is emailed via Emergent-managed email and cannot be read in the browser; only step transition is verifiable in UI.
